intro.title: Build end to end capstone React plus TS enterprise dashboard
intro.body: In this capstone project, you will build a complete enterprise dashboard application from scratch using React and TypeScript. You will learn how to structure a real-world project by creating reusable components, managing application state, and fetching data from an API. The core programming concepts you will practice include defining strict TypeScript interfaces for your data, using React hooks for state and side effects, and composing components to build a complex UI. By the end, you will have a functional dashboard that displays key metrics and charts, solidifying your understanding of how React and TypeScript work together in a professional front-end application.
intro.usecase: This lesson builds a comprehensive enterprise dashboard, a core UI pattern used in real-world business applications like Salesforce, Google Analytics, and internal admin panels. Developers implement these dashboards to display key metrics, interactive charts, and data tables for monitoring performance, sales, or system health. Mastering this pattern equips you to create data-rich, maintainable interfaces that are central to modern SaaS products and internal tools, where TypeScript ensures data integrity and React enables dynamic, component-based updates.
